# Accepted by the parser and codec::encode but never printed by codec::decode.
# Format: stable syntax name<TAB>accepted input.
decimal_digit_separators	<num(0_00'0012'345)>
octal_prefix	<num(0o000_5151)>
binary_prefix	<num(0b0000'1111'0000'1111)>
hexadecimal_prefix	<num(0x1234_5678)>
decimal_prefix	<num(0d_5555)>
